Entropy-based change detection between two images

Source: R/entropy-maps.R
change_map.Rd

Applies the entropy test of entropy_test() pixel by pixel, using the observations of a moving window in two co-registered images, and returns the map of p-values and the binary change map.

Usage

change_map(
  image1,
  image2,
  model = c("gamma", "g0i", "ggamma", "wishart", "g0p"),
  window = 5,
  L = NULL,
  channel = 1,
  level = 0.01
)

Arguments

image1, image2

Co-registered images (SARImage objects or arrays) of the same size.

model

One of "gamma", "g0i", "ggamma" (intensity models, applied to each channel) or "wishart", "g0p" (matrix models, for PolSAR images).

window

Odd side of the moving window.

L

Known number of looks. If NULL (default) it is estimated in every window.

channel

Channel used by intensity models.

level

Significance level used to declare a change.

Value

A list of class sitsar_change with the matrices statistic, p_value and change (logical), and the level.

Examples

set.seed(1)
a <- matrix(rgammasar(40 * 40, mu = 1, L = 4), 40)
b <- a
b[11:30, 11:30] <- rgammasar(400, mu = 4, L = 4)
cd <- change_map(a, b, model = "gamma", window = 5, L = 4)
cd
#> <Entropy-based change map> model: gamma | level: 0.01 
#>   size: 40 x 40 
#>   changed pixels: 543 (33.94%)
plot_map(cd$change, main = "Detected changes")
